hook: Your AI gives you the same answer it gives everyone. That's the problem.
caption:
Your AI gives you the same answer it gives everyone. That's the problem.

Here's what nobody talks about: ChatGPT doesn't know if you're someone who needs the full theory before you can trust the conclusion — or someone who needs the conclusion first and will google the theory later.

It doesn't know if bullet points make your brain light up or make you feel like you're reading an IKEA manual.

It doesn't know that when you say "make it shorter" you mean *sharper*, not just *fewer words*.

So it guesses. Every single time. And you spend the next 4 messages trying to correct it back to something useful.

That correction tax? It adds up.

15 minutes here. A prompt that went sideways there. An output you used anyway because you were tired of fighting it.

BootFile fixes the part that comes *before* the prompt — who you are as a thinker. How you process. What "good" actually looks like to you.

One profile. Every tool. No more starting from zero.

Link in bio to build yours. It takes 10 minutes and your AI will never feel like a stranger again.
